product_metadata.title: Imperial Home 50x60 Soft Fleece Throw Blanket, Throw Blanket for Couch, Travel, Bed, Room, Travel Essentials, Fleece Travel Blanket, Lightweight Blanket, Fall Blankets & Throws, Cozy Blanket (Yellow)
features: SIZE: This fleece throw blanket is 50 x 60 inches, making it the perfect size for a sofa throw, sofa bed, twin bed, queen bed, king bed, college dorm room, loveseat, etc., and also a perfect pet blanket for pet bedding, crates, etc. A throw blanket perfect for any space!

TRAVEL FRIENDLY: Made from 100% polyester and 180 GSM fleece, a warm yet thin blanket that is easily portable. This is the perfect travel blanket to take with you on an airplane, camping, road trip, etc. yet can also be used as a great throw for anywhere around the home or office. You can really take and use the blanket anywhere for a layer of extra warmth!

VERSATILE: A versatile soft fleece throw blanket that can be used all year round. The soft blanket is warm enough to stay insulated during the winter, yet lightweight enough to keep you comfortable during summer evenings.

COUCH THROW: A warm blanket that can act as a great couch throw, and help bring a nice rustic decor into your home. A nice fall throw blanket, or neutral enough to where you can bring it out any time of the year. A cozy blanket you can curl up in to watch movies, read a book, etc.

EASY CARE: A fleece blanket that's not only easy to travel around with, but also easy to take care of! You can place the blanket in the washing machine and tumble dry on low heat. Easy to maintain, and will last you many years to come.
